title: Amoytiinu Tiddigille Karawad
intro: Daqaaral tan baaxo, namma verdant garden, kee sissin qaynatih qasriino — takkay immay tet addal tan ummatta ken barkatteh tan numih hangisso sinnim dadalte. Kassiisitte keenih seecak temeete wak, oson wonnah yuduureenih. macaay kataytem digaala too uxih maabitinah qagaaqagitak. Ta dumaahi ayyunta miyyak sugteeh?
clues: Nanu elle mannownam baaxol kaxxam barkat le too ni buxa namma caxaaxuwi caxaaxuwih fanat tan.
Nanu ni baaxol caxitta daqoorit ruffa inneeh, ni buxaaxi kibbimtah tan mango gaaboysot ruffa inne.
uxih nanu gadda geynuh seecimne wak ninni Rabbih ammirtimiyya, nanu kaxxiinit wonnah wadirih gacne.
Ni gadda kee sahli inkih neh yeceeh yan num nee habbalseh.
Tokkeek nanu elle kibal luk sugne kaxxa adaf tiggileh tan garciik weeqi yemeete.
Nanu Saba’h ayyuntaay, baaxok kaxxa Ma’rib Karawwadih aaxaguk sugne.

outcome.label: Ni Saami
options: namma qeero caxaaxuwi arac nek caxaaxuwi tiya ciggiileh
Ni caxaaxuwi arac lafet lennal dadle
Ni agat taban kee namma kedoodal kurrumte.
outcome.answer: namma qeero caxaaxuwi arac nek caxaaxuwi tiya ciggiileh

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
